content.title: About
content.content: Baby Toddler meat sticks are a ready‑to‑eat snack for toddlers from 1 year old. Made from 100 % lean beef, they contain no artificial colours, flavours or preservatives. The sticks have a soft texture, convenient size and a mild taste, making them easy for young children to chew.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Each stick provides about 30 % of the daily protein needs for a growing child.
The product meets strict quality standards and complies with Russian GOST for baby food.
Beef is sourced only from certified farms that follow strict antibiotic‑use regulations.
Sticks are packed in airtight vacuum packs that keep them fresh for up to 12 months.
The formula is free from gluten, soy and nuts, reducing the risk of common allergens.

items.title: High in protein
items.content: Beef protein supports muscle growth and the development of a strong immune system in toddlers.

items.title: Source of iron
items.content: Iron helps form haemoglobin and prevents iron‑deficiency anaemia.

items.title: Contains zinc
items.content: Zinc is essential for normal growth, wound healing and immune function.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The sticks contain a moderate amount of fat, making them suitable for daily consumption.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamin B12 and B6 support nervous system development and metabolism.

items.title: Beef allergy
items.content: Some children may be allergic to beef; discontinue use at the first sign of reaction.

items.title: Choking hazard
items.content: Not suitable for children under 1 year; sticks may pose a choking risk for younger infants.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: For children on a low‑salt diet, monitor total sodium intake from all foods.

items.title: Post‑opening storage
items.content: After opening, keep the product refrigerated and consume within 3 days.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Meat sticks can be served as a standalone snack or chopped into baby puree, porridge or vegetable stew. For extra softness, gently warm in the microwave (no more than 30 seconds) before serving.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place at 5 °C–25 °C. Once opened, keep refrigerated and use within 72 hours. Discard after the expiration date printed on the package.
